title: canonaut: A Safe Rust Implementation of the nauty Graph Canonicalization Algorithm
description:
canonaut is a native, memory-safe Rust implementation of the nauty graph canonicalization and automorphism-group algorithm (McKay 1981; McKay & Piperno 2014). Canonical forms are byte-identical to those of C nauty, so canonical hashes computed by the two are interchangeable. The library supports dense graphs, canonical labeling, vertex-coloured (partitioned) canonicalization, digraphs, automorphism group generators, graph6 I/O and the Schreier–Sims stabiliser chain, and ships Python bindings of the same name with arbitrary hashable node labels and networkx interoperability.

This deposit is the archived snapshot accompanying the SoftwareX article, and includes the reproducible capsule in repro/, which regenerates every table and figure of the paper.
